goal: A thesis author can build an editable template-driven basic DOCX from deterministic renderer-neutral typed instructions.
non_goals: Do not implement real figures, table borders or caption fields before task 004.
Do not implement OMML, Word fields, footnote package parts, multiple sections, headers, footers or page-number fields before task 005.
Do not load or format bibliography data before task 006.
Do not implement atomic replacement or failed-build preservation before task 007.
Do not add UI, network, account or AI dependencies.
expected_evidence: Red and green RenderPlan, Compiler, DOCX and CLI tests
Typed instruction coverage for every V1 block type
Deterministic numbering, bookmark, reference and citation-order evidence
Direct DOCX package/XML assertions for page, body and heading formatting
Full pytest, Ruff and pip check output
Offline build command and generated package inspection
Task report, independent spec review and independent quality review
unsafe_assumptions: python-docx defaults do not satisfy the selected template.
Parser and Renderer must not calculate final numbering or bookmark names.
Core public APIs must not expose python-docx or OOXML implementation objects.
Duplicate bookmark names must fail explicitly.
Advanced later-slice behavior must not be claimed from editable fallback text.
stop_condition: Stop if implementation would cross Parser/Domain boundaries, require later-slice advanced Word behavior, or edit outside the allowed files.
